items.title: AI means fewer graduate jobs – how to make sure they still exist in the future
items.description: Graduate recruitment at Britain’s leading employers has fallen by almost a quarter in three years. As AI is making graduate trainee jobs an endangered species, Grace Lordan argues that a youth employment strategy has to be built around the bottom rung of the ladder by rewarding firms for sustaining graduate hiring. items.description: Devolution, Andy Burnham’s flagship policy, is an opportunity to deepen local democracy. items.title: Net zero and growth go hand in hand
items.description: Net zero is often criticised as being responsible for high energy prices and for stalling economic growth. In her interview to Anna Bevan, Anna Valero argues that not only does net zero not stall growth, but that innovating and adopting technology that contributes to net zero enhances economic productivity.
